subject: Game Theory
title: What Is Signaling?
description: A quick win: understand What Is Signaling?.

hook.text: A peacock's enormous tail is useless for flying. But it signals fitness: 'I survived despite this handicap.'

buildup.text: Signaling is a costly action that reveals hidden information. Only those with the quality can afford the signal.

discovery.text: Michael Spence showed that education can work this way—degrees signal ability, not just teach skills.

twist.text: If signals are too cheap, everyone sends them and they lose meaning. Cost is what makes signals credible.

climax.text: Luxury brands, charitable donations, and tough job interviews all function as costly signals.

quiz.question: Why must signals be costly to work?
options: Only those with the quality can afford them
